svg.text: Overview -Multiple cores and multi threads. -All threads have the same processing cycles -Initial clock speed are the same for all cores -Core speed is dynamically modified during simulation -Core speed affects the power level for "Active" state -The combination of speed and power impact task allocation on cores and the response time.

Four parallel threads -All have same task time, task generation rate, priority but an unique ID for plotting purpose Initially all the Threads start execution in the same cycle. One experiment is to vary the Thread activity relative to the others. To do this, we change the Start Time of the Task Generator. We have a parameter called Task_Cycle_Shift.
Four Processor Cores -Starting clock speed is same -Custom scheduler allocates arriving tasks to the first available core -Cores described using Schedulers
Power Manager: -Maintains the Power table for each core and for each power level -Output is instant, average and battery discharge
